system.description:
You collect surrounding water to create a single Hydra stinger extending from your back. When you cast this jutsu you can make a melee ninjutsu attack and for its the duration you can use your bonus action to make a Hydra Stinger attack.

Hydra Stinger. melee Ninjutsu attack against a creature within 15 feet, dealing 3d6 Cold damage On a hit. Once per turn, an affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, if the target would regain hit points or chakra points before the beginning of your next turn, it gains vulnerability against the next successful attack from this jutsu until the end of your next turn. You must have at least 1 Stinger available.

If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or this jutsu also deals 3d6 chakra damage on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, you manifest 3 stingers allowing you to take the Hydra Stinger Shield attack as a Reaction. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, you manifest 6 stingers allowing you to take the Hydra Stinger Swarm attack as an Action. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you manifest 9 Stingers allowing you to take the Hydra Stinger Symphony attack as an Action.

Hydra Stinger Shield. As a Reaction to taking damage, you reduce the triggering damage by 4d8. Doing so spends 1 of your Stingers. If you have less than the needed Stingers you cannot use this, Action.

Hydra Stinger Swarm. Make 3 melee ninjutsu attacks against a target up to 15 feet away, dealing 3d6 cold damage for each successful attack. Doing this spends 1 of your Stingers. If you have less than the needed Stingers you cannot use this, Action.

Hydra Stinger Symphony. All creatures of your choice must make a Dexterity saving throw as all your stingers strike out slamming and stinging with aggressive focus repeatedly. On a failed save, affected creatures take 8d8 cold damage and gain a rank of Chilled or half as much damage on a success. Doing this spends 2 of your Stingers. If you have less than the needed Stingers you cannot use this, Action.
